title: Patch: an open daily board and the Daily list show a game ended on the opponent's move without a reload

**Issue #3840 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3840: Patch: an open daily board and the Daily list show a game ended on the opponent's move without a reload
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

A follow-up to daily games (#3727, merged in #3762), found in its review and left out of it. Part of the tracker #3726.

### What happens

An open daily board (`/daily/<matchId>`) and the Daily list (`/daily`) reread only when `dailyWaiting` changes. That number, sent on the social socket, counts the games waiting on *you*. When the opponent ends the game on their own move (they concede, or it otherwise ends while it is their move), the count doesn't change, so your open page keeps showing the game as running until you reload.

- [`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx:93`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx#L92-L98): rereads only on a change of `dailyWaiting`, and only while the move isn't yours.
- [`apps/web/src/daily/DailyRoute.tsx:367`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/apps/web/src/daily/DailyRoute.tsx#L357-L372): the list reads once (`usePolled(getDaily, null)`, no interval) and then only on a change of `dailyWaiting`.
- The count comes from `crates/server/src/social/` (`dailyWaiting` in the social snapshot).

### What should happen

A daily game that ends, whoever's move it was, shows as ended on an open board and an open Daily list without a reload (§9.13).

### How to reproduce

Two friends in a daily game. With the move on B, A keeps `/daily/<matchId>` open; B concedes. A's board still shows the game running. The same holds for A's `/daily` list.

### Fix, either way

- **(a)** The server's social frame also carries a number that moves whenever any of the player's daily games changes (a version or a counter), and the web rereads when it moves. Cleaner; touches the server and the web.
- **(b)** The web also rereads when the tab regains focus or becomes visible, and on a slow interval, a named constant in `apps/web/src/daily/config.ts` (CLAUDE.md rule 9). Touches only the web.

Add a test that fails without the fix: in `DailyBoard.test.tsx` and `DailyRoute.test.tsx`, a game that ends on the opponent's move is shown as ended without a reload (for (a), when the new number moves; for (b), on focus or the interval). For (a), also a server test that the number moves on such an end.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43696340590)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

A daily game that ends shows as ended on an open board (`/daily/<matchId>`) and on an open Daily list (`/daily`) without a reload. This holds whoever's move it was: the opponent concedes on their move, the opponent concedes while the move is the player's, or a deadline passes. The fix is option (b) of the issue, web only. Both screens read the server again every `DAILY_REREAD_MS` (a named constant in `apps/web/src/daily/config.ts`) while the tab is visible, and once more when the tab shows again. Tests in `DailyBoard.test.tsx` and `DailyRoute.test.tsx` fail without it.

## Files to touch

| File | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/daily/config.ts` | change | add `DAILY_REREAD_MS = 60_000` |
| `apps/web/src/daily/DailyRoute.tsx` | change | `usePolled(getDaily, DAILY_REREAD_MS)`; header comment |
| `apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx` | change | one `useEffect` with `pollWhileVisible`; header comment |
| `apps/web/src/daily/DailyRoute.test.tsx` | change | two `R3840000` tests |
| `apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx` | change | two `R3840000` tests |
| `spec/rulings/R3840000.md` | new | the ruling, `proven_in` both test files |
| `spec/pending/3840.md` | new | the ruling's §11 paragraph |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | one sentence at the end of §9.13's "The client." bullet |
| `apps/web/README.md` | change | "Daily games" section (the `/daily` and `/daily/:matchId` entries) |

Do not touch:
- `crates/**`, `apps/edge`, `e2e/**`. The server's social frame stays as it is.
- `apps/web/src/together/socialPoll.ts`, `apps/web/src/game/net.ts`, `apps/web/src/together/session.ts`.
- `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

1. **`apps/web/src/daily/config.ts`.** After `DAILY_TICK_MS` add:
   ```ts
   /** How often an open daily board and the Daily list read the server again while the tab shows, and (R3205000) once more when it shows again. The social read's `dailyWaiting` counts the games waiting on the player, so a game that ends on the opponent's move, or while the move is the player's, leaves it unchanged (R3840000). A minute is slow on purpose: a move that does change the count is read at once. */
   export const DAILY_REREAD_MS = 60_000;
   ```
2. **`apps/web/src/daily/DailyRoute.tsx`.**
   - Add `import { DAILY_REREAD_MS } from "./config.ts";` next to the other `./` imports.
   - In `DailyRoute()` change `usePolled(getDaily, null)` to `usePolled(getDaily, DAILY_REREAD_MS)`. `usePolled` already runs `pollWhileVisible`, so a hidden tab reads nothing and the tab showing again reads once. Leave the `dailyWaiting` effect as it is.
   - Header comment lines 6-9: add "and every `DAILY_REREAD_MS` while the tab shows and when it shows again (R3840000: a game can end with the count unchanged)".
3. **`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx`.**
   - Add `import { pollWhileVisible } from "../game/net.ts";` (after the `Game` import) and `import { DAILY_REREAD_MS } from "./config.ts";` (after the `DailyClockPill` import).
   - Directly after the `waitingSeen` effect (ends line 107) add:
     ```ts
     // R3840000: a game can end on the opponent's move, or while the move is the player's, with the count of games waiting on the player unchanged,
     // so the board also reads on a slow period and when the tab shows again (R3205000: a hidden tab reads nothing). Nothing changes once over.
     useEffect(
       () =>
         pollWhileVisible(() => {
           const shown = current.current;
           if (shown !== null && !shown.over && !sending.current) reread();
         }, DAILY_REREAD_MS),
       [reread],
     );
     ```
     There is deliberately no `hasMove` condition, and the existing `waitingSeen` effect stays unchanged.
   - Header comment lines 13-15: after "(the opponent moved)" add "and every `DAILY_REREAD_MS` while the tab shows and when it shows again, which shows an end the count does not (R3840000)".
4. **`spec/rulings/R3840000.md`** (new). Front matter:
   ```
   ---
   id: R3840000
   title: "An open daily board and the Daily list read the server again every DAILY_REREAD_MS while the tab shows, and when it shows again, so a game that ends on the opponent's move shows as ended (issue #3840, amends §9.13's client)"
   cards: "§9.13, R3205000, R3727000, issue #3727, issue #3840"
   proven_in:
     - apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx
     - apps/web/src/daily/DailyRoute.test.tsx
   ---
   ```

   - **The gap.** The social read's `dailyWaiting` counts the games waiting on the player. A concede or deadline on the opponent's move leaves it unchanged, and the board reread only on a change while it was not the player's move. An opponent's concede while the move is the player's lowers the count, but the board ignored it.
   - **The rule.** `/daily` and `/daily/<matchId>` read again every `DAILY_REREAD_MS` (60 s), a client constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9), while the tab is visible. They read once when it shows again, via `pollWhileVisible` ([[R3205000]]). The board does not read once its game is over, nor while its own action is in flight. The `dailyWaiting` read stays for moves that change the count.
   - **Presentation only** (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
   - **Rejected:**
     - (a) a server version number in the social frame. It needs a new store query on both stores, a wire field and a contract test, for a result the slow read also gives.
     - Rereading on every social frame (`challengeReads`). A chat or friends frame would reread the daily screens.
     - A seq guard that drops an older answer. The race is rare and heals on the next read or a `stale` refusal.
5. **`spec/pending/3840.md`** (new), one paragraph in the form of `spec/pending/3912.md`:
   `**[[R3840000]] An open daily board and the Daily list read again on a slow period and when the tab shows (issue #3840, 2026-11-15)**: amends [[§9.13]]'s client. …` Give a short summary of the ruling and its rejected options, ending with "It takes R3840000 and edits [[§9.13]]."
6. **`spec/09-architecture.md`.** Edit the unique sentence "The Play hub's Daily entry and the screen's title count the games waiting on the player." to be followed by: " An open board and the Daily screen also read the server again on a slow period while the tab shows, and when it shows again, so a game that ended on the opponent's move, or while the move was the player's, shows as ended without a reload ([[R3840000]])."
7. **`apps/web/README.md`**, "Daily games" section:
   - `/daily` entry: replace "read again when the social read's dailyWaiting changes" with "read again when the social read's dailyWaiting changes, every DAILY_REREAD_MS while the tab shows and when it shows again (R3840000)".
   - `/daily/:matchId` entry: after "none for a voided game)" add "; read again the same way until the game is over, so an end on the opponent's move shows (R3840000)".
8. Write the tests (next section), then run the commands.

## Tests

Test names start `R3840000 ` so `cargo jackioh spec check` counts them. Both new tests in each file use fake timers for intervals only: `vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["setInterval", "clearInterval"] })`. This is the pattern of `DuosRoute.test.tsx` ("R2092000 the status is read again…"). Real `setTimeout` stays, so `findBy…` and `flush()` work. Both files also need:
```ts
import { resetVisibility, setVisibility } from "../test/setup.ts";
import { DAILY_REREAD_MS } from "./config.ts";
async function flush(): Promise<void> {
  await act(async () => {
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
  });
}
```
Add `afterEach` lines `vi.useRealTimers(); resetVisibility();` after the existing `cleanup()`. In `DailyBoard.test.tsx` also add `act` to the `@testing-library/react` import.

**`apps/web/src/daily/DailyRoute.test.tsx`**, a new `describe("R3840000 the open Daily list reads a game that ended", …)` with a `ended()` helper:
```ts
list() with games "theirs" → { ...g, over: true, hasMove: false, theirMove: false, deadline: null, result: { outcome: "win", reason: "concede" }, endedAt: Date.now() }
```
- `R3840000 a game that ended on the opponent's move shows as finished on the slow read, with dailyWaiting unchanged`:
  - Set `world = { list: list(), dailyWaiting: 2 }` and `serve(world)`.
  - Render, then `await screen.findAllByTestId(dailyTestid.gameRow, undefined, SLOW)`.
  - Assert `rowOf("theirs")` has `data-over="false"`.
  - Set `reads = server.to("GET","/api/daily").length`, then `world.list = ended()`.
  - Run `await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(DAILY_REREAD_MS); }); await flush();`.
  - Assert the GET count is `reads + 1` and `rowOf("theirs")` has `data-over="true"`.
  - Advancing the clock never touches `dailyWaiting`, which stays 2, so the old code fails here.
- `R3840000 a hidden tab's Daily list reads nothing and reads once when the tab shows again`:
  - Same setup. Record `reads`, set `world.list = ended()`, then `act(() => { setVisibility("hidden"); })`.
  - Assert the count is still `reads`. Then `act(() => { setVisibility("visible"); })` and `await flush()`.
  - Assert the count is `reads + 1` and the row is over.

**`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx`**, a new `describe("R3840000 the open daily board reads a game that ended", …)` at the end of the file, with `const GAME = "/api/daily/games/g-1";`.
- `R3840000 a game the opponent ends on their own move shows as ended on the slow read, and is read no more`:
  - Initial read: `dailyGame({ hasMove: false, legal: [CONCEDE], view: baseView({ active: "p2" }), holds: [] })`.
  - After a flag `ended = true`: `dailyGame({ seq: 8, over: true, hasMove: false, legal: [], holds: [], view: baseView({ active: "p2", result: { winner: "p1", reason: "concede" } }) })`.
  - Render, `await screen.findByTestId("concede", undefined, SLOW)`, and assert `queryByTestId("result-overlay")` is null.
  - Record the GET count, set `ended = true`, and advance `DAILY_REREAD_MS` as above.
  - `await screen.findByTestId("result-overlay", undefined, SLOW)`, assert the count rose by 1.
  - Advance another `DAILY_REREAD_MS` and `flush()`. The count must not move, since an ended game is read no more.
- `R3840000 a game the opponent concedes while the move is the player's shows as ended when the tab shows again, and a hidden tab reads nothing`:
  - Initial read is the default `dailyGame()` (`hasMove: true`). The ended answer is `dailyGame({ seq: 8, over: true, hasMove: false, legal: [], holds: [], view: baseView({ result: { winner: "p1", reason: "concede" } }) })`.
  - Render and `await screen.findByTestId("end-turn", undefined, SLOW)`. Set `ended = true`.
  - `act(() => { setVisibility("hidden"); })` and assert the GET count is unchanged.
  - `act(() => { setVisibility("visible"); })` and `await screen.findByTestId("result-overlay", undefined, SLOW)`.
  - Assert the count rose by 1.

If `findBy…` stalls under the faked interval, replace it with `await flush()` (twice if needed) and a plain `getByTestId`. If the interval test cannot be made stable after a real try, keep the visibility tests and say so in the report.

Commands:
```
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/daily/DailyRoute.test.tsx
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/daily/order.test.ts src/routes/play.test.tsx src/inbox/InboxBell.test.tsx
pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/daily
cargo jackioh spec check
cargo fmt --check
```
The web tests build the wasm first through `pretest`. The planner did not run them because `wasm/pkg` is not built in the planning worktree.

## Done when

- [ ] `DAILY_REREAD_MS` is a named constant in `daily/config.ts`; no other new number appears in the web code.
- [ ] `DailyRoute` reads the list every `DAILY_REREAD_MS` through `usePolled`, so a visible tab and a tab that shows again both read.
- [ ] `DailyBoard` rereads on the same period and on `pageWake`, with no `hasMove` condition, skipping when `over`, `null` or `sending`.
- [ ] The four `R3840000` tests pass, and each fails without the fix (check by stashing nothing: reason it from the code, or temporarily revert step 2 or 3 locally and put it back).
- [ ] The existing daily tests still pass: `DailyBoard.test.tsx`, `DailyRoute.test.tsx` and `order.test.ts` (Risks covers other suites that count `/api/daily` reads).
- [ ] `R3840000.md`, `spec/pending/3840.md`, the §9.13 sentence and the README lines are in.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check`, `typecheck` and `eslint` are green; no `eslint-disable`, `.skip` or `.only`.
- [ ] Final report names every command run and lists the decisions below.

## Risks

- **Existing tests that count reads.** Intervals fire only after 60 s of real time, so tests that count reads do not move. Fake-timer tests in the new describes restore real timers in `afterEach`.
- **Read racing a send.** The board skips a tick while its own POST is in flight. A read that started just before a send can still return after the send's answer and show the older `seq`. This is rare and heals on the next read or on the `stale` refusal that rereads (`DailyBoard.tsx` `send`). A seq guard was not added, to keep the change minimal.
- **Load.** One `GET` a minute per visible daily tab is far under R109's 300 requests a minute per account. A hidden tab sends none (R3205000). A board reads the game by loading and folding it, which is the same cost as any board read.
- **Hidden information (rule 7).** The reads are the same routes the screens already use, so they reveal nothing new.
- **Spec check.** Every `R3840000` mention in the code, tests or comments needs `spec/rulings/R3840000.md` (step 4) in the same change.

## Open questions

- **Decision recorded:** option (b) over (a). (a), a server version number on the social frame, is cleaner and instant. It needs a new `Tx` query on `pg.rs` and `fake.rs`, a store contract test, a wire field and web parsing. By the difficulty rule that is "design across crates", i.e. hard, which this medium item is not. If a person wants (a), it needs its own hard issue. The slow read can stay as a fallback.
- **Decision recorded:** 60 s, equal to `DAILY_TICK_MS` but named separately (it means something else). A person may prefer 30 s or 120 s; it is one constant.
````
